name: FNCE 5344
title: Enterprise Risk Management
description: A review of the Financial Risk Management program. Reviews the accounting requirements associated with asset valuation and income recognition of complex portfolios that utilize advanced hedging techniques. Analyzes an organization’s control environment and processes within COSO and SOX frameworks and examines the control practices that organizations use to help ensure the integrity of information provided by its accounting systems. Tax-related issues and Basel II are also discussed.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
